checker_fingerprint_method: For each path below, sha256 of the file content as stored in git at engine_commit (LF, checkout-independent). One line per file, 'path  sha256\n', sorted by path. The fingerprint is the sha256 of that listing.

deficiency_statements.query-coverage-unstructured: v1's query-side coverage exists only as unstructured captured stdout. It is readable but not machine-diffable. A rule going non-zero to zero on the query path cannot be detected by a golden diff against this baseline.
deficiency_statements.retrieval-contains-generated-echo-line: retrieval-baseline.txt contains one generated line — question 11's planner echo — and is therefore not fully deterministic. The retrieved event sets are identical across all 16 questions; only the echo varies. Reproducing the file requires the planner, which is why retrieval_reproduction is skipped.

notes: The chronicle, the held-out sections and renders.json were taken from a directory named 'pre-v1.2-generation'. The chronicle is nonetheless the correct baseline: both v1.2 reports state the post-v1.2 chronicle is byte-identical — same 8 suspect tokens, same 3 sections held out — and no chronicle was written to out/ afterwards.

The findings sidecar in that same directory was NOT correct. It is pre-v1.2 checker output, and the directory holds a mix. The anchor here was reproduced from renders.json by the checker at engine_commit; the pre-v1.2 file is archived beside it as chronicle-42.findings.pre-v1.2.json with role historical-not-anchor and must never be used as a diff target.

The prose is hand-verified. The findings sidecar is derived — a pure function of (renders.json, checker code), recomputable at zero inference cost through 'wb book --check-only'. That is why it could be reproduced rather than copied without weakening the baseline.
Question set archived as C# source (QuerySuite.cs), not as data. Teaching the suite to emit it as data is a Stage 4 item.
QuerySuite.cs is pinned '-text' in .gitattributes as of commit c368a6f, so the 9312-byte LF form recorded here is a property of the artefact rather than of the checkout.

answers-final.txt is the v1 query artefact: all 16 answers, the per-answer finding lines (zero on all sixteen) and the coverage table, as captured stdout. No query-side findings sidecar exists and none was manufactured for this baseline.

artefacts.source_path: produced by 'wb book --check-only' from renders.json at engine_commit (verification 5a)
